sloka: त्यज शोकं च मोहं च दुःखं च जनकात्मजे ।रामलक्ष्मणयोरर्थे नाद्य शक्यमजीवितुम् ।। ६.४८.३३ ।।।।
transliteration: tyaja śokaṁ ca mohaṁ ca duḥkhaṁ ca janakātmaje ।rāmalakṣmaṇayorarthe nādya śakyamajīvitum ।। 6.48.33 ।।।।

translations.english: "O Janaka's daughter! You give up grief and delusion about Rama and Lakshmana. They are alive, no doubt."
